_about: Public-domain J. C. Philpot (1802-1869, Strict Baptist, for twenty years editor of the Gospel Standard; not John Philpot the Marian martyr) for the Word Hoard: his Letters (London: J. Gadsby, 1871), raw Internet Archive OCR. No pre-1930 scan of his sermons or of the Meditations was found; the Gospel Standard volumes he edited are many authors' magazines and are not claimed as his. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 17 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
